messages:
alex: Quick heads-up: we need a compatibility plan for v1->v2 routing that minimizes surprise billing and support tickets. thinking soft-exemptions + console flags.
maya: Agree. Do we tag traffic so billing and migration metrics can be separated?
jon: Proposal: router emits X-Redwood-Compat: mode=[anchor|grace] for routed v1 traffic that was kept by policy. Telemetry ingests that tag and we exclude those tokens from "migration spike" alerts.
sara: Console needs a clear internal banner and an override button for CS to revoke an exemption. Also show expiry.
lucy: I'll mock two rows in migration dashboard: "compat-exempt" tenants and "pending-migration". Filterable, sortable by expiry.
pm-ryan: PM asks for default windows: 30 days for anchors, 14 days for experimental grace. Legal wants copy reviewed.
ops-bot: Note: global cap required. If too many anchors stay on v1, autoscaler will misallocate. Suggest a rollout flag `compat-anchor-cap` (percent of v1 pool).
deploy-bot: Router + header injection + telemetry flag PR ready. Staging smoke ok. Canary plan?
alex: Canary: 3h at 2% then evaluate. Sampling: 100% of compat-tagged traffic for 48h, then 5%. Alerts: billing-delta >25% OR v1-util >65% => page.
maya: I'll wire alerts and separate billing-exclusion rule.
jon: I'll implement router order: pin -> version-header -> compat-check -> fallback, and ensure idempotency.
sara: I'll own console revoke end-to-end and notification to CS.
lucy: Mock screenshots by EOD.
alex: Good. I'll draft the runbook and share link. Objections?
pm-ryan: none from PM side—just want legal copy in.
ops-bot: Reminder: add metric "compat_exempt_count" for SRE monitoring.
